description: Ground V3KTR has traveled. The topographic view buffers each feature by properties.radius_m, or by default_radius_m when that is null. Fog covers everything outside those buffers. Coordinates are display meters, [east, north], except a feature with reanchor_pending true: those coordinates are the previous origin frame and are not drawn. Example features stay hidden unless the page is opened with ?demo=1. Do not invent a path. Schema: id, example, world, radius_m, date, source, notes, reanchor_pending. See the README.

properties.notes: Dragons Lair Base was visited on 2026-11-12. These coordinates are the previous Eden origin, not meters from Talon's Public Outpost. The offset has not been measured. Not drawn until that offset is stored. The radius is not a surveyed boundary.
EXAMPLE. Hidden demo track for ?demo=1. Not a path V3KTR walked. It crosses the example grass polygon so the sheet can be checked.
